description: This file defines the TimesheetColumn class in the OrangeHRM Time module. It encapsulates a date and a total value, providing methods to access and modify the total, as well as retrieving the date.

classes.name: TimesheetColumn
classes.description: Represents a column in a timesheet, holding a specific date and an associated total.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a TimesheetColumn with a specific DateTime.

methods.name: getDate
methods.description: Returns the date associated with this timesheet column.

methods.name: getTotal
methods.description: Returns the total value accumulated for this column.

methods.name: incrementTotal
methods.description: Increments the total by a specified amount and returns the new total.
